jobs.description:
Feel the authentic.
Park Plaza Victoria Amsterdam is a historic and vibrant hotel, located opposite Amsterdam Central Station. With a diverse range of Food and Beverage outlets and a high-energy environment, it is the perfect place to develop your skills and gain hands-on leadership experience.

As our Food and Beverage Management Intern, you gain insight and experience in the execution of managerial duties while working closely with the Food and Beverage leadership team. The wide variety of our Food and Beverage concepts gives you the opportunity to broaden your horizon as you contribute to daily operations, team coordination, and commercial performance, ensuring smooth service delivery and memorable guest experiences.

This internship starts in September 2026 and offers a full-time learning experience for a minimum of 5 months, aligned with your study requirements.

Responsibilities

• Support the Food and Beverage Manager in daily operations across all outlets

• Lead by example on the floor, ensuring excellent service and guest satisfaction

• Assist in coordinating restaurant, bar, breakfast, and event operations

• Drive commercial performance by supporting upselling, promotions, and events

• Monitor service quality and ensure brand standards are consistently maintained

• Support team communication, shift organisation, and operational planning

• Assist with training and coaching team members

• Engage with guests, ensuring personalised and memorable experiences

• Take ownership of assigned projects to improve performance and guest satisfaction

Essential Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a hospitality, hotel management, or related study programme

• Strong communication skills in English, written and spoken

• Passion for food, drinks, and guest service

• Proactive, organised, and eager to learn in a dynamic environment

• Availability for an internship of at least 5 months

• Eligible to complete an internship in the Netherlands

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a production job in Gouda? As a Production Worker, you help keep the production process running smoothly. Together with your team, you work on cutting, packing, filling and labeling food products. At the start of your shift, you check the production line with your team. Once everything is ready, the production process begins. You help keep the line running and make sure products are processed correctly. Together with your colleagues, you make sure everything runs smoothly.

Your tasks include:

- Working on a production line with about 5 colleagues
- Cutting, filling, packing and labeling food products
- Keeping the workplace clean and organized
- Performing quality checks during production
- Reporting small issues or deviations to the operator

You play an important role in the production process.

Working in a production environment requires teamwork, accuracy and a practical mindset. This role suits someone who enjoys hands-on work and working together with colleagues.

Requirements:

- MBO working and thinking level
- English and/or Dutch language skills
- Accurate and motivated work attitude

Preferred:

- Experience in production or factory work
- Ability to work in a busy production environment
- Attention to safety and hygiene
